messages:
Nina (Product): Follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: capturing customer wins/losses and the feedback loops. Please add one-line notes — what actually tipped deals and the recurring asks.
Raj (Head of Sales): Win: gaming platform picked us for low jitter and predictable token cost on heavy concurrent chat. Loss: utilities company went with an on-prem vendor because of strict key custody + regulatory retention.
Izzy (CS): Two common asks: 1) customer-managed KMS 2) longer retention windows for traces/logs. Also several customers asked for explainability traces per response.
Marco (SE): Loss detail: utilities required deterministic audit logs and signed server-side responses for each inference. They said our SDK made it possible but needed a clear compliance cert path.
Tess (Infra): On the jitter front, the win came from our recent scheduling tweak + per-tenant queue isolation. The perf delta was visible in the demo: `tail latency down ~40% under load`.
Raj (Head of Sales): Top asks I hear across deals: customer KMS/HSM, retention tiers (90d/365d/7yr), explicit SLA for burst tail latency, and a simple "how we pass audits" doc for procurement. Those 4 remove most friction.
Ellen (CEO): Good synthesis. Tactical (30-60d): attestation template + audit checklist, Dedicated/Private one-pager, and a short-term retention toggle. Strategic (quarter): customer-managed keys + signed response capability.
Nina (Product): Proposed action owners: - Raj: compile top 15 lost deals with exact blocker (72h) - Marco: draft signed-response feasibility + perf impact (72h) - Tess: retention toggle feasibility + infra cost estimate (72h) - Izzy: audit checklist draft + sample answers (48h).
Marco (SE): For signed responses, initial idea: HMAC per response using customer key or a Redwood-signed token chain. I'll sketch API and perf tests.
Tess (Infra): Will run cost simulation for 7-year retention and estimate storage + eg. archival retrieval times.
LegalBot: Note: scoped attestation template v0.1 uploaded to /legal/templates/attestation-v0.1. Product & Security review required before use.
Izzy (CS): I'll include customer quotes/examples to make the checklist concrete. Also, can we prioritize 3 accounts for expedited attestation? Raj, can you flag those.
Raj (Head of Sales): Flagging 3 strategic accounts in the GH project I'll create. Also sales needs a one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private controls for procurement. Two-week turnaround requested.
Nina (Product): I'll create the GH project and invite Product, Sales, CS, Infra, and Legal. Quick sync scheduled Fri 09:00 PT to review owners. Link after GH creation. Keep replies short. :rocket:
Ellen (CEO): Thanks — keep momentum. If teams need temporary attestation approvals, escalate to me with the rationale. :thumbsup:
